name: Permanent Residence by Family Relationship

requirements.blocker_text: Married to, or in a recognized common-law union (union de hecho) with, a Guatemalan citizen for at least 1 year qualifies for permanent residence via IGM's RP3 category. Requires apostilled/legalized foreign documents, a criminal record certificate, migration movement certification, and proof of income. Processing runs roughly 3-6 months.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 1 year of marriage or recognized union with a Guatemalan citizen, then apply to IGM.

requirements.blocker_text: A separate track exists for relatives of a Guatemalan citizen 'within the legally established degrees' -- IGM's own RP3 form is titled specifically for this category, but which degrees qualify (children, parents, siblings) was not detailed in the sources reviewed for this build.
requirements.fix_path: Apply to IGM under the RP3 family-relationship category with proof of the qualifying relationship.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or proof of common-law union

sources.title: Agencia Ocote (independent Guatemalan news/explainer outlet) -- permanent residence by marriage/union (1 year) and by family relationship within legal degrees, documentary requirements
